description: Change the KMS protection key of a secret (DEFAULT service key or a USER_MANAGED_KEY by kmsKeyTag). kmsBoundaryType is required in the KR region (JPN is always ISOLATED).

keyIsolation.description: Which Secret Manager host to call: 'global' (default) for secrets encrypted with a KMS global key (secretmanager.apigw.ntruss.com); 'regional' for secrets encrypted with a KMS region-isolated key (ocapi-kr.ncloud.com/secretmanager — the only option in the JPN region)

kmsBoundaryType.description: KMS key isolation: GLOBAL or ISOLATED (required in KR)

kmsKeyTag.description: KMS key tag — required when protectionKeyType=USER_MANAGED_KEY

name: ncloud_secret_update_protection_key
